title: Language Exchange & Monopoly Game with Auckland International Friends
description:
**Join Us for a Vibrant Language & Culture Exchange! Love monopoly game?**

Looking to practice your English, meet amazing people from around the world, and explore diverse cultures—all in one fun evening?
✨ **Auckland International Friends** invites you to an exciting **Language Exchange and Monopoly Game Meetup!**
Whether you're a native English speaker or learning English as a second language, this event is for anyone eager to connect, communicate, and celebrate cultural diversity.

📍 **Inspired by the warm vibes of our past gatherings** at Gilli Café Newmarket and Rose Garden Café, this meetup will take place in a cozy, relaxed setting perfect for meaningful conversations and new friendships.
🎉 **What to Expect:**

* Fun, interactive language games
* Cross-cultural conversations and activities
* A chance to share your own culture and learn about others
* Friendly faces and great coffee (or tea!)

👫 Come alone or bring a friend—everyone is welcome! Whether you're new in town, a world traveler, or a local looking to expand your network, you'll find a place here.
📍 **Location:** Gilli Café, Newmarket, Auckland

143 Carlton Gore Road, Newmarket, Auckland 1023

A small $2–$5 NZD donation per Meetup is appreciated to help cover organisation costs.

Bank Details:
Mr A SAMANTA
12-3164-0889217-02

Everyone Please buy something from the cafe to support the venue.
Let’s connect over languages, laughs, and cultures. We can’t wait to meet you!

title: 0x25 Auckland Meetup at AUT CSI
location: 74 Governor Fitzroy Place, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1010, Auckland
description:
**WHAT TO EXPECT**
Join us for another Hack The Box meetup in Auckland! Whether you're thinking about being a hacker or are already a seasoned one, this event has something for everyone.

**A massive shoutout to AUT Cyber Security & Intelligence (CSI) Club for opening their doors to us and sponsoring the event venue and catering.**

The event will include a guided walk through of a security challenge, demonstrating essential tools and techniques for enumeration, exploitation, and privilege escalation. Attendees will have the opportunity to network and collaborate with other members.

At the end, we will do a raffle where we will give out HTB prizes, such as VIP access to the platform and HTB Academy cubes.

This is an on-site event in Auckland CBD.

**WHAT YOU GET**

* A chance to win some HTB giveaways
* Access to our HTB dedicated lab during the event

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* A laptop.
* A HTB account.
* Discord application.

**HOUSE RULES**

* Follow all rules and guidelines in the **[HTB TOS: HTB Terms of Service](https://www.hackthebox.com/tos)**
* Active HTB content cannot be shared publicly. Retired challenges or machines are fair game.
* **AUT CSI Club** host the event to support the growth of the local cybersecurity community and to support students and professionals in their journeys to learn. Respect for the venue and people is expected from all attendees.

**ADDITIONAL NOTES**

* Join our Discord for event discussion, upcoming event announcements, and CTFs here: **[https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu](https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu)**
* Free parking is not available at the location.

* Smoking
* Drinking alcohol
* Any form of discrimination or racism
* Any other forms of misconduct

title: Japanese/English Exchange group ENKAI（縁会）
description:
日本語と英語で話そう！Let's join Japanese/English Exchange group ENKAI（縁会）!

Learn Japanese/English, make friends, learn about culture!All Levels Welcome!Are you looking for opportunities to practice your Japanese or English? Have fun meeting new people while practicing your target language with native speakers. Plus, you get to return the favor and help others reach their goal to become fluent in another language! Not only will you walk away feeling like you've improved your English or Japanese, but you'll also feel great about helping someone else reach his or her goals. Let's enjoy ENKAI!

This event only allows attendees that are 18 years old or older.

Fee: $11 to be paid at the counter (Includes regular flat white, coffee, tea, or a fizzy drink)

title: OWASP New Zealand - Auckland Meetup
description:
Join us for the next **OWASP New Zealand Chapter** meetup! We are gathering the local application security community for an evening of technical talks, networking, and knowledge sharing.

* **When:** Tuesday, 8th September 2026
* **Where:** **Lightspeed Office** 2 Nuffield Street, Newmarket, Auckland 1023, New Zealand
* **Time:** 5:30 PM (Doors open for networking), 6:00 PM (Presentations begin)

We present an introductory talk about the OWASP Top 10 (2025 edition) with a new item each meeting. With the new edition OWASP Top 10, we're starting at A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration.

**Thanks to Our Host**
A big thank you to [Lightspeed](https://www.lightspeedhq.com/au/) for sponsoring the venue and catering and for supporting the local security community.

**Agenda**

* 6:00 PM OWASP Introduction, Top 10
* 6:30 PM Break
* 6:45 PM Technical Talk

**Technical Topic Speaker: TBC**
TBC
**Talk Title: TBC**
TBC
\-\-\-\-
OWASP Auckland is on Meetup for now - please watch this space.

We're always looking for presenters and topics for future meetings - contact Austin (austin.chamberlain@appsec.org.nz) if you have an idea for a topic, or a presentation you'd like to make. That way, it won't always be Austin talking about what he's been working on recently.

The Auckland-area OWASP Meetup usually takes place on the third Tuesdays of March, May, July, September, and November. There is no Meetup in January, as our members enjoy their holidays.

title: AKL Multi-Model Copilot, Autonomous Agents & Token ROI
description:
Join us for an exclusive evening with visiting GitHub Engineers **Marco Celon** and **Amanda Tan** as we explore the next evolution of AI-assisted software development. Beyond traditional code completion, modern developer workflows now demand seamless orchestration across multiple surfaces, diverse AI models, and autonomous agents—all while keeping enterprise token budgets under control.

Whether you are looking to supercharge your personal developer flow or scale AI productivity across an entire organization, this session delivers actionable strategies straight from the team building these tools.
What We'll Cover:

* **Multi-Surface & Multi-Model Integration:** Learn how to route developer workflows across IDEs, CLI tools, and cloud agents while leveraging diverse models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) tailored to task complexity.
* **Token ROI & Cost Control:** Master practical techniques for context window optimization, prompt hygiene, and enterprise budget caps to keep token consumption efficient and cost-effective.

**Agenda**
5:30 - Pizza and networking
6:00 - Talks
7:00 - Finish

Please make sure to register for the event as we need to provide contact details to Microsoft for security purposes. Registration will close 48 hours prior to the event to provide enough time to send out the access passes for in-person attendees, but you can [join online](https://aka.ms/aotearoanzgithub/stream) on the day.

If you have a topic you'd like to present (or hear about) please reach out, or create an idea in our [GitHub Ideas discussion board](https://github.com/orgs/NZ-GitHub-UG/discussions/categories/ideas).
